title: DC Studios’ New Green Lantern Animated Series Confirms Episode Count With Promising Update
content:
Warner Bros. Animation and DC Studios are now in the works on a new animated series set in the same universe as My Adventures with Superman , and Peter Safran has shared a promising update on how it’s all coming along with a confirmation of how long it’s debut outing is going to be. My Adventures with Green Lantern has been announced as an extension of the My Adventures with Superman universe, and features a young hero that quietly made her first appearance during My Adventures with Superman ‘s third season .

There have been some worries among fans as the animated series has been in development during the course of Warner Bros. and Paramount’s merge into Skydance , but everything continues to move forward as DC Studios co-chairman and co-CEO Peter Safran told Collider that they are currently “reviewing animatics and animation” for My Adventures with Green Lantern ‘s ten half-hour episodes.

My Adventures with Green Lantern Confirms Episode Count With Production Update

When asked about My Adventures with Green Lantern and whether or not it shares any similarities with its My Adventures with Superman predecessor, Safran revealed that the new animated series is “Tonally similar,” but remarked that “Obviously, thematically very different because it’s dealing with different characters and different lore , but the things that I loved so much about My Adventures with Superman are firmly in My Adventures with Green Lantern .” Thankfully, it also seems far into its production process too, “We’re in the stages of reviewing animatics and animation on that right now.”

My Adventures with Green Lantern has been confirmed to take place within the same universe as the Superman series, and that’s great news considering that My Adventures with Superman has yet to reveal any word on its own potential future with a fourth season . All those involved behind the scenes seem to be down for it, but it’s going to be up to DC Studios as to whether or not the main animated series continues. At least this new spinoff will have something great to chew on in the meantime.

What to Know for My Adventures with Green Lantern

My Adventures with Green Lantern has yet to confirm a release window or date as of the time of this writing, unfortunately. Featuring My Adventures with Superman producer Jake Wyatt as executive producer and Stephanie Gonzaga as co-producer, the new animated series will star Auli’l Cravalho as the voice of a young Jessica Cruz following her cameo debut in My Adventures with Superman Season 3. But it’s going in a different direction than that main series with a different anime as the source of inspiration.

As for what anime it’s going to be influenced by, Wyatt teased that it’s going to feel familiar to classic Toonami anime fans much like how their rebooted take on Superman was, “Our take on Superman is very obviously inspired by Dragon Ball Z , among other things; there’s a lot of anime influence. Lantern is inspired by a very different part of the same Toonami block.” There’s a theory that it’s going the Sailor Moon route, and that makes it all the more intriguing.

What are you hoping to see from My Adventures with Green Lantern ? Are you excited to see this animated universe continue? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – Collider

title: Romelia War Chronicle Anime's 2nd Part Unveils April 2027 Debut, Ending Song's Artist
content:
The staff of the television anime of Ryō Ariyama 's Romelia War Chronicle: Even After Defeating the Demon King, Humanity Still Seems Doomed, So I Formed a Military Force ( Romelia Senki: Maō o Taoshita Ato mo Jinrui Yabasō Dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita ) light novel series announced the April 2027 television premiere and the ending theme song artist for the anime's second cours (quarter of a year) on Saturday. Hiro Shimono is performing the ending song for the second part.

Seven Seas licensed the novels' manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam. With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.

The anime premiered first via streaming in Japan on U-NEXT , Anime Times , and Netflix on October 3 at 9:00 p.m. (8:00 a.m. EDT). The anime then aired on October 5 at 11:30 p.m. (10:30 a.m. EDT) on the Tokyo MX , BS11 , Sun TV , and KBS Kyoto channels. The anime will run for two cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired.

Ariyama launched the light novel series as a web novel on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2019, before being published under Shogakukan 's Gagaga Bunko imprint. The series currently has over 550,000 copies in circulation, and ended in its sixth volume in November 2025. Kodama illustrated the first novel volume and Ryō Kamito illustrated volumes 2-6.

Seven Seas released the third volume on August 11.

The manga series adaptation with art by Ryō Kamito launched on Mag Garden 's Mag Comi platform in January 2022.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms It’s Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes With Perfect Score After Finale
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has officially wrapped up its debut season with Paramount+, and the series has been Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes with a rare perfect score among critics. Avatar: Seven Havens made its long awaited debut earlier this month, and it takes the extended Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise forward hundreds of years after the events of The Legend of Korra . And the first season of the series has been a major hit with fans and critics alike for its episodes so far.

Avatar: Seven Havens was already starting out on the right foot as it initially made a rare perfect score of 100% debut with Rotten Tomatoes . But with the final episodes of the first season debuting this weeknd with Paramount+, Rotten Tomatoes has now confirmed that the animated series has been Certified Fresh with that same perfect 100% score according to 21 critic reviews thus far . It’s an impressive return for the animated franchise for sure.

Avatar: Seven Havens Ends Season 1 as 100% Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes

Avatar: Seven Havens Book One runs for 13 episodes overall, and they are now all streaming with Paramount+. Book Two has been confirmed to be on the way with another wave of 13 episodes, but has yet to confirm its own release date or window as of this time. The animated series has been a big return hit for Avatar Studios thus far as the sequel expanding on this wider universe has already been confirmed for two more seasons . Much like its predecessors, Avatar: Seven Havens will run for at least four seasons in total.

Avatar: Seven Havens executive producer Sehaj Sethji previously confirmed to ComicBook that Seasons 3 and 4 of the animated series are now in the midst of production with voice stars Saheli Khan (who voices Pavi) and Aishu Devan (who voices Nisha) already reading scripts and recording lines for what’s to come. Which is a good sign for the future of the animated series as it likely won’t be too long of a wait before each new season of the series hits. Especially if it wants to keep up this hot streak on Rotten Tomatoes.

What’s Next for Avatar Studios?

Avatar: Seven Havens is one of the only new projects that Avatar Studios now has in various levels of production. Franchise creators Michael DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko have revealed the studio is now working on a new spinoff prequel series all about Kuruk, Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos . A release window or date has yet to be revealed for this new series, but it’s a promising further expansion of the wider Avatar Studios world as fans are hoping to see more than ever.

“When Brian [Konietzko] and I came to start Avatar Studios, since we were developing multiple things at once, we were very conscious of making sure each project felt different in genre and tone style and everything,” DiMartino explained to ComicBook in how the two of them decide which projects to pursue with full series. It seems like if the idea seems like it’ll make for a different series than seen before, it’s ripe for the exploring.

How did you feel about Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ debut season? Do you think it deserves this perfect score? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love Anime Reveals New Trailer, Opening Theme Song Artist
content:
Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love anime revealed a new trailer and the opening theme song artist on Saturday. Cosplayer Enako will sing the opening theme song and will also voice the character Nene Haneshita. The series is slated to premiere in January 2027.

Studio Sakura Create is animating the series with Kazuya Komai as director. Deko Akao is in charge of the series composition while Shohei Hamaguchi is designing the characters. The cast includes:

• Riko Akechi as Rinna Milford Isshiki

• Shuichiro Umeda as Meishi Rokutanda

• Haruki Ishiya as Danjuro Iwata

• Takuma Nagatsuka as Masato Nakatani

• Hiiro Ishibashi as Chikai Matsumoto

• Yu Wakui as Rena Yamakawa

The anime is based on a manga series written and illustrated by Ayune Araragi. Kadokawa Shoten’s Monthly Shonen Ace magazine has been serializing the title since June 2020. Before, it was serialized under the title Rinna Keibu wa Kokyu ga Dekinai in Ichijinsha’s Monthly Comic Rex magazine between October 2016 and December 2017.

Yen Press is publishing the manga in English describing it as follows: The straitlaced and serious police inspector Isshiki has earned the respect of everyone around her, but lately, she hasn’t quite been herself at work. Whenever her coworker Rokutanda is around, she gets flustered and slips up! Having no experience with such complicated feelings, Isshiki decides to enter a pseudo-relationship with Rokutanda and figure out what this love thing is all about!

title: Hiragi-san's House of Vampires Gets Anime
content:
Hiragi-san’s House of Vampires manga by Miki Yoshikawa ( A Couple of Cuckoos ) is getting a TV anime adaptation by TMS’s Unlimited Produce. A visual was also unveiled:

Yoshikawa initially launched the series as a one-shot in Kodansha’s shonen manga magazine Weekly Shonen Magazine in 2019. Bessatsu Shonen Magazine then acquired the title in 2021 and has six volumes in circulation. The manga is also available in English on Kodansha’s K manga digital platform, describing it as follows: Every family has its own “secrets”… Meet our protagonist, Shota Minamoto, a junior-high student who also happens to be an orphan in a children’s home. One day, he was adopted by a family living in a luxurious, Japanese-style estate. Welcomed warmly by them all, Shota started letting his guard down, but this family had a “secret” that the world could never know. A new work from the creator of “The Cuckoo’s Fiance” showcasing a different kind of “family.” Thus begins a cozy, bloody love comedy! title: Comisma, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank Establish Anime Production Fund
content:
COMISMA stated the fund will enhance financial support for creators and "offer new investment opportunities to investors who have previously had little access to the anime production business." COMISMA and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank will jointly establish and operate the fund.

COMISMA is the parent company of both the manga app GANMA! and the anime studio Qzil.la . The fund aims to combine COMISMA and Qzil.la 's ability to acquire popular IPs and anime production expertise with the bank's investor network. The fund will offer new investment opportunities to companies that have been interested in entering the anime production business but have found it difficult to access.

COMISMA stated production capacity has not kept pace with strong demand, with many established and major studios being booked to capacity years in advance.

The announcement referenced the Japanese government's recently announced goal to roughly triple the anime industry's overseas market in less than 10 years, with a 6 trillion yen (about US$37 billion) goal for 2033. The Association of Japanese Animations (AJA) had announced on Thursday the overseas anime market in 2025 was 2.54 trillion yen (about US$16.1 billion).

title: Cosplayer Enako Sings, Voice-Acts in Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love Anime
content:
Kadokawa presented the full promotional video for the television anime of Ayune Araragi 's Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love ( Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai ) manga on Saturday. The video announces that Enako is both singing the anime's opening theme song "Gō Yoku Koi o Seisu!?" and joining the cast as the nurse Nene Haneshita.

The romantic comedy follows Isshiki Rinna Milford, an elite, straight-laced officer who joined the police at age 17 (but has not experienced romantic love), and Meishi Rokutanda, a kind but scatterbrained and incompetent detective. As two newbies at love, they become a couple (of sorts) as they find out about romance.

The anime will star Riko Akechi as Isshiki Rinna Milford and Shūichirō Umeda as Meishi Rokutanda. The other cast members include:

• Haruki Ishiya as Danjuro Iwata

• Takuma Nagatsuka as Masato Nakatani

• Hiiro Ishibashi as Chikai Matsumoto

• Yū Wakui as Rena Yamakawa

Kazuya Komai (episode director for Tenjho Tenge , BECK: Mongolian Chop Squad , Pita-Ten ) is directing the anime at Sakura Create . Deko Akao ( Komi Can't Communicate , Noragami , The Case Study of Vanitas ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Shōhei Hamaguchi ( Glamorous Heroes ) is designing the characters.

Other staff members include:

• Prop Design: Noriyasu Murata

• CG Director: Satomi Nakajima

• CG Production: Studio Twinkle

• Color Key Artist: Akiko Saito

• Art Director: Yasutada Kato

• Compositing Director of Photography: Daisuke Horino

• Editing: Yūsuke Ueno

• Sound Director: Masanori Tsuchiya

• Music: MICHIRU

• Music Production: Kadokawa

Araragi launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine in June 2020. Kadokawa published the manga's 10th compiled volume on May 25, and will publish the 11th volume on December 24.

Yen Press has licensed the manga for release in English, and released the first volume on October 13. While Yen Press initially licensed the manga under the title Ms. Isshiki Wants to Know About Love , the company is now releasing the manga under the title Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love .
author: ANN

title: Supporting Cast for 'Kaze wo Tsugumono' Announced
content:
The official website for the Kaze wo Tsugumono ( Inherit the Winds ) original television anime announced supporting cast on Saturday. An advance theatrical screening will run for two weeks starting November 13. The anime will premiere in January 2027 at 11:30 p.m. on the Agaru Anime programming block on CBC and TBS' 28 affiliated stations.

Cast Nishiki Niimi: Daisuke Hirakawa ( Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria ) Kisaburou Kawai: Toshiyuki Toyonaga ( Mao ) Kyuusai Momoyama: Kappei Yamaguchi ( Yomi no Tsugai ) Toshimaro Yoshida: Toshiki Kumagai ( Tongari Boushi no Atelier )

Tomohiro Kawamura ( Neko Neko Nihonshi ) is directing the anime at Drive and Live2D Creative Studio . Azuki Mashiba is providing original work cooperation. Fumi Ebina is designing the characters, while Shigeru Kishida ( Rilakkuma to Yuuenchi ) is composing the music.

Playwright Yutaka Narui , founder of the theater troupe Caramel Box and known for the Tachikawa Jinsuke stage play series including the Shinsengumi-themed Kaze wo Tsugumono , is penning the script for the anime. Narui is also co-credited for the original work with Aniplex .
author: MyAnimeList

title: Final Fantasy XIV Game Reveals February 19 Early Access Date for 'Evercold' Expansion, New Job Zephyr
content:
The Final Fantasy XIV Fan Festival 2026 event in Tokyo on Saturday revealed that the "Evercold" expansion for Square Enix 's Final Fantasy XIV MMORPG will launch on February 19 for early access, and officially on February 23. Pre-orders begin on November 4. The release date is a delay from the previously announced January 2027 release.

English Full Trailer

Japanese Full Trailer

The event also revealed a video revealing the new job Zephyr, a ranged DPS.

The event also revealed videos highlighting the new areas "Sessrymnir, Realmship of Earth" and "Skiðblaðnir, Realmship of Wind," and new dungeons.

Lastly the event revealed a new video for the previously announced collaboration with the Neon Genesis Evangelion series titled "Ghosts of Desire." The collaboration is bringing on guest creator Mahiro Maeda ( Evangelion: 3.0+1.0: Thrice Upon A Time , Evangelion: 3.0 You Can (Not) Redo ).

The game is adding two new jobs in the patch: Bastion and Zephyr.

The game's director and producer Naoki Yoshida (also known as Yoshi-P) revealed at the Fan Festival event in Anaheim in April that "Evercold" will begin the series' new "Godless Realms" saga. Players will enter the Fourth, one of 13 reflections of the original Source world. He also teased various creatures including a "Wanderer," Arcane Giants, and a new race of cat creatures. The new expansion will also bring changes, including an updated Adventurer Activity user interface and a more weekly-based system as opposed to daily.

The new expansion will also feature a collaboration with Final Fantasy VII Remake , with a new eight-player raid series titled "Beyond the Lifestream: Fated Collision." The raid series will include a new "Fierce" difficulty level.

Square Enix released Final Fantasy XIV Online for personal computers in September 2010. After criticism from fans, the company revealed an updated version of the game titled Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn that added a new world and story. Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn launched on Windows PC and PlayStation 3 in August 2013, on PlayStation 4 in April 2014, on PlayStation 5 in May 2020, and on Xbox Series X|S in March 2024. The game's Nintendo Switch 2 version launched on August 4.

Square Enix has since released five expansions: "Heavensward" in June 2015, "Stormblood" in June 2017, "Shadowbringers" in July 2019, "Endwalker" in December 2021, and "Dawntrail" in July 2024.

The game has now recorded 35 million registered accounts worldwide.

The game's mobile version for iOS and Android devices from Lightspeed Studios launched in China in June 2025, and had planned to have a global launch. However, the game ended service in the Chinese mainland on September 30, with the global version seemingly canceled.

Square Enix announced in February 2022 that it will continue support for the MMORPG for the next 10 years.

title: Inherit the Winds Anime Reveals 4 More Cast Members, New Visual
content:
The staff for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) revealed four more cast members on Saturday.

The new cast includes (left to right in above image):

• Daisuke Hirakawa as Niimi Nishiki

• Toshiyuki Toyonaga as Kawai Kisaburō

• Kappei Yamaguchi as Momoyama Kyūsai (name romanization not confirmed)

• Toshiki Kumagai as Yoshida Toshimaro

Additionally, the staff announced that scriptwriter and original creator Yutaka Narui is writing a novel for the franchise that Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha, Ltd. will ship on December 24. Narui separately wrote a short story for the franchise that was published on Thursday in Japanese only on the anime's website .

The staff also revealed a new autumn visual for the anime on Thursday.

The anime will then debut in January 2027 on the "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated networks.

The anime takes place in the Bakumatsu era in Kyoto. A solider who has lost his memories is aided by the famous Shinsengumi member Okita Sōji. Okita Sōji names this man "Tachikawa Jinsuke." Jinsuke's life begins anew amidst the Mibu soldiers.

The anime will star ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ):

• Daisuke Sakuma (Snow Man member) as Tachikawa Jinsuke

• Yūki Kaji as Okita Sōji

• Aoi Yūki as Koganei Hyōgo

• Kōki Uchiyama as Hijikata Toshizō

• Yūichi Nakamura as Kondō Isami

• Nichika Ōmori as Kurosuke

• Ryōhei Kimura as Nagakura Shinpachi

• Ayumu Murase as Tōdō Heisuke

• Simba Tsuchiya as Harada Sanosuke

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Yamanaka Keisuke

• Yasuyuki Kase as Serizawa Kamo

• Takaya Kamikawa as Umeda Shinbei

Yutaka Narui and Aniplex are in charge of the original story with cooperation by Azuki Mashiba . Tomohiro Kawamura is directing the anime at Live2D Creative Studio and Drive Inc. Narui is also writing the scripts. Fumi Ebina is the character designer, and Shigeru Kishida is composing the music.

Quruli and hitsujibungaku are performing the television anime's opening theme song "Kaze wo Tsugumono" (Inherit the Winds) and ending theme song "Namida no Kawa" (River of Tears). The latter is also the theatrical screening's theme song.

The anime's four-panel manga adaptation launches on Star Seas Company 's Twi4 (read as Tsuiyon) X (formerly Twitter ) account in 2026. Matsuri Muramatsu draws the manga.

Narui is a playwright and founder of the theatrical troupe Caramel Box who has previously worked on many stage plays themed on the Shinsengumi. While one of the plays was also titled Kaze wo Tsugumono , the way the title is written is different (with "mono" being written in kanji for the play and in hiragana for the anime), and the anime is still listed as being an "original" TV anime.
